text:
Lina: Quick heads-up — Orbit QBR in 10 days (Thu 2pm PT). Need: one-slide health snapshot, onboarding runway (ETA + owners), top renewal signal (one line), and one clear exec ask. Drop bullets by Mon EOD pls.

Owen: I'll own the health slide. Plan: p95 latency, top 3 error classes (connector timeouts, auth failures, 429s), and a 30d trend for active seats.

Priya: I'll take onboarding runway. Current cohort of 5: 3 green, 1 blocked on SSO, 1 blocked on dataset schema. Est: SSO 3 business days w/SE; schema 7 business days. I'll add owners & next steps.

Marcus: Renewal signal = AMBER for two strategic accounts. Demo instability is the callout. Exec ask idea: temporary SLA credits for demos + 30 SE hours to triage and stabilize. Will draft impact bullets.

Lina: Marcus, paste a 1-line renewal blurb we can put verbatim on the slide (one sentence + one mitigation bullet).

Marcus: "Renewal risk: AMBER — two strategic accounts experienced demo failures during exec POCs; mitigation: grant temporary SLA credits for demo reliability and prioritize 30 SE hours for fixes."

Owen: For health slide, do we want to show cost delta for the SLA credits/pilot? I can add a small before/after cost row.

Priya: Yes include a single line cost delta. Also add owners for the SSO/schema blockers (SE: Mike; Data eng: Sanya).

Lina: Logistics: deck link -> https://drive.redwood/Orbit-QBR-Runway (please add your slide by Wed 9am PT). Dry run Wed 3pm PT. ops-bot will post invite.

ops-bot: Created calendar event: Orbit QBR dry run  Wed 15:00 PT. Invitees: Lina, Owen, Priya, Marcus.

Owen: I'll highlight routes: text.generate + embeddings.lookup and attach the p95 chart.

Priya: Added onboarding timeline and owner matrix to Drive. Tagged Mike and Sanya for action.

Marcus: Uploaded incident notes and ticket #4505 summary (demo timeouts). Included brief repro steps and suggested quick fixes.

Lina: Nice. Two small asks: (1) keep text on slides short (no more than 2 bullets per slide), (2) include one customer quote (anonymized) on the health slide.

Owen: Adding one-liner: "Quality is strong; demos fail intermittently when large datasets connect" (anonymized).

Priya: If legal sign-off for SLA credits needed, who do we loop in? Lina: legal or finance?

Lina: Loop Legal (>legal@redwood) only if Marcus' ask goes past a simple credit note. Finance should be FYI. I'll escalate if needed.

Marcus: I'll draft the exec ask slide with objective, ask (credits + SE hours), expected outcomes (reduced demo failures, higher renewal probability), and cost estimate.

Lina: Recap timeline: slides in Drive by Wed 9am PT; dry run Wed 3pm PT; final deck to exec Thu 11am PT. Thanks team  ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

Owen: Added charts and cost row.

Priya: Confirmed owners looped and ETAs set.

Marcus: Drafted exec ask and uploaded to Drive.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Orbit QBR final deck due Thu 11:00 PT.

Lina: Perfect. If anything changes DM me.
